title: Artemis Astronaut Announcement
description: Vice President Mike Pence and NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine announce initial "Artemis Team" of 18 astronauts.
keywords: Artemis, astronaut, Pence, Bridenstine, Moon, Apollo Saturn V
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
